item.title: Pirate Nations-inspired Booty Wars rebooting the vibe with “high-stakes PVP”
item.summary: Two weeks after blockchain gaming studio Proof of Play shut down, a key community member from its Pirate Nation game is attempting to build a successor, albeit without the studio, the PIRATE token, and most of what made the original game “official” in the first place.
